mapper.sql: select sy.user_id as userId,sy.user_name as nickName,d.TENANT_ID as tenantId, d.TENANT_TOWER_DEPT_ID as tenantTowerDeptId, d.TENANT_NAME as tenantName, d.id, d.dept_id, d.parent_id,d.parent_name, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.dept_level,d.bussness_unit, d.update_time, CASE WHEN d.parent_id = '1' THEN NULL WHEN d.parent_id = '100000' THEN d.dept_id ELSE d.parent_id END province, CASE WHEN d.parent_id = '1' THEN NULL WHEN d.parent_id = '100000' THEN NULL ELSE d.dept_id END city from sys_dept d left join sys_user sy on sy.DEPT_ID=d.DEPT_ID and sy.tenant_id = d.TENANT_ID left join sys_user_role sur on sy.USER_ID = sur.user_id where d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select dept_id as deptId, dept_name as deptName from sys_dept where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and parent_id = '000000' and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'

select tenant_id as tenantId, tenant_name as tenantName from sys_tenant_info
tenant_id like concat('%',#{tenantId},'%')
or tenant_name like concat('%',#{tenantName},'%')
select distinct sr.role_id as roleId, sr.role_name as roleName from sys_role as sr left join sys_tenant_info as ten on sr.tenant_id = ten.tenant_id
select a.tenant_name from sys_tenant_info a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
select USER_NAME from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * from sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0' and DEPT_ID like concat(#{deptId},"%")
select * from sys_user u where u.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_name = #{userName}
select * from sys_user u where u.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_id = #{userId}

select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_type, u.nick_name, u.tenant_id as tenantId, i.enforcement, i.adopt ,i.login , i.create_by, i.create_time,i.update_by, i.update_time from sys_user u left join sys_enforcement_info i ON i.user_id = u.user_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.user_id = #{userId}
